title: NAILS config --json
description: Machine-readable config envelope (contract version 2): one document for `config path`, `config show` or `config validate`. The data shape differs by subcommand (path/exists, the effective configuration with its sources, or path/valid), so data is validated only as an object; the envelope frame and the error body are strict. `config show --example --json` is a usage error. A Ctrl+C or SIGTERM before the result is the shared cancel shape: the error `cancelled`, no data, exit 130. An internal error is the error `internal_error`, exit 1.
